text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] region-silence detected for eu-central-4. Multiple control-plane probes failed. Severity P1. Auto-fanout to #incidents.

maya_ops: got the alert. is this control-plane-only or do we have data-plane drops?

jason_infra: starting quick checks. k8s control-plane logs show etcd connection timeouts and api-server 503s.

leah_sre: Grafana: node-heartbeat and api-server alerts firing. API 5xxs ~35% in past 5m. traffic not fully failing over.

tom_net: traceroute from edge -> eu-central-4 shows consistent packet loss after POP-3. possible provider backbone issue.

emma_support: support queue: ~12 Dedicated customer tickets referencing "service slow" from eu-central-4. flagging high priority.

jason_infra: controller logs snippet:
```
2026-03-21T12:10:02Z controller: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset
2026-03-21T12:10:04Z etcd: unreachable: all endpoints timed out
```

maya_ops: recommend starting controlled failover. any region with headroom? eu-west-2 has spare capacity right now.

oliver_oncall: taking lead. actions: 1) set region state=degraded, 2) disable autoscaler in eu-central-4 to stop noisy provisioning, 3) begin staged traffic shift to eu-west-2.

leah_sre: propose staged percentages: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, verify P95 and token success at each step. also toggle model-variant fallback to lower-memory quantized models during shift to relieve GPU pressure.

jason_infra: listing pinned Dedicated placements and private VPCs before migration. 9 Dedicated pools, 2 private VPC peers. none are mid-migration. will not evict unless customer OK or emergency.

tom_net: opened provider ticket PROV-86200: they report a fiber cut between POP-3 and eu-central backbone. ETA initial fix 40-90m.

incident-bot: Runbook: begin-evacuate logged (operator=oliver_oncall, target=eu-central-4, ts=2625004350).

oliver_oncall: initiating 5% traffic shift now. router policy updated to route 5% to eu-west-2.

emma_support: posting status update to status.redwood.ai: "Partial outage impacting eu-central-4, staged failover in progress. Dedicated customers notified."

jason_infra: eviction progress: 6/100 critical pods drained. prioritizing small-cache models first. ETA 25m to reach 25% drain at current rate.

leah_sre: watchlist for cutover: token success rate, P95 latency, GPU util, API error rate. enabling extra retention in observability for this region.

tom_net: provider update: "traffic reroute in progress via alternate POPs; we still see congestion. repair crews en route." (PROV-86200).

oliver_oncall: proceeding to 25% shift once token success rate stays >98% for 3 consecutive minutes.

maya_ops: reminder: Dedicated customers must be given migration window. support will call top-3 enterprise customers in eu-central-4 now.

jason_infra: switching model fallback flags: enabling quantized-8bit variants for large-context models in eu-west-2 to speed import and reduce memory pressure.

leah_sre: good to document: if provider repair exceeds 2h, escalate to exec comms and consider multi-region sustained migration for certain Dedicated pools.

emma_support: support escalation: two customers requested pause; relaying to product for potential manual pin.

incident-bot: next automated check in 2m. all actions appended to incident timeline.

oliver_oncall: summary: provider fiber cut likely root cause, staged failover to eu-west-2 underway, Dedicated customer coordination in progress, monitoring closely for failed migrations or model degradation. will update in-channel every 5m or on major state changes."
